conflicts: Two free-entry lists disagree on the same official site. The static list on message.html (and on notice.html) includes 在职公安民警. The JS '参观信息' tab inside Page/WxyGarden/notice.html omits it.

The official site has two versions of the visitor notice. The homepage (articleview/index.html) has 12 items and adds a ban on feeding or photographing animals, and it lacks the explicit smoking/drone/flash list. notice.html has 14 items. No conflicting values.
The Shanghai gov pages describe the 40 differently: 'over 40 scenic spots' on the scenic page versus 'six scenic areas boast over 40 ancient structures' on the parks page.

stale_source: the english.shanghai.gov.cn pages were updated Aug 13, 2025 (c4, c36) and Oct 22, 2025 (c37). The first is more than 12 months before 2026-10-11. yugarden.com.cn has news dated 2026-08-07, so it is current.

notes: Dotonbori c17 is wrong, and so are the description and the first highlight: the source names かに道楽 (가니도라쿠), not 구이다오레.

Yu Garden c17-c24 and c26: the cited URL Page/WxyGarden/notice.html shows the ticket info by default. The 游览须知 text is in a JS-rendered tab on the same page, and the same text is at https://www.yugarden.com.cn/page/articleview/notice.html, which is a better URL to cite.
WebFetch was not used. Every page was fetched with curl and returned 200. yugarden.com.cn sometimes fails on the first try (code 000) and loads on retry.
collector_unconfirmed, Dotonbori: duration, reservation, payment, language, parking and district fees are not on osaka-info, dotonbori.or.jp or tonbori.jp. tonbori.jp gives walking times for access.

collector_unconfirmed, Yu Garden: duration, payment methods, language/Korean guide, real-name or passport booking and the reservation opening time are on neither the official site nor the Shanghai gov pages. The facilities page (设施信息) is empty.
dotonbori.or.jp (c3-c5, c14, c15) and tonbori.jp both date from about 2015 and should be flagged stale_source. Find a newer official source for the airport transfer times.
